models.primary_failure: Invented SOP-FUEL-SMOKE-001 when retrievedEvidence was empty

models.name: Qwen3-4B

selection_rule: Choose the smallest model only when every configured repeat passes every candidate-model gate
known_limitations: The benchmark contains only 12 controlled seed cases
The run used direct Transformers inference rather than vLLM concurrency
RAG retrieval quality was not evaluated because retrieved evidence was supplied in each case
The current injection metric does not detect malicious instruction text repeated in summary fields
Results are engineering acceptance evidence, not production accuracy claims
